body:
The non-in_time methods appear to be unused.

Might it simplify the api surface (and reduce duplicate code) to keep only the in_time variation?
I exposed them as same way with linear and cubic, but indeed, they might not be necessary for now. I recall that why we kept the cubic one was for curves or something like that
